processing_issue_detail.message: Extracted 20 row(s) for list field(s) Transactions, but the section's OCR text contains about 42 rows in 3-column table(s) of that shape — the list is likely truncated. The run still reports success and scalar fields are unaffected, so no other signal flags this. Simple extraction returns one response per section and stops early on long lists; for documents this size use Advanced (agentic) extraction, which shards. Setting minItems on the list field adds a second signal for the same shortfall; in Simple extraction it makes the loss visible without changing the outcome, and extraction.row_shortfall_action is what decides that.
